setup: A quotient of two fractions is estimated.

steps.say: The dividend is [[a]]/[[b]] and the divisor is [[c]]/[[d]].
The quotient answers how many copies of the divisor fit into the dividend.
Rewriting the division as multiplication by the reciprocal places the quotient on the same scale as whole numbers and benchmarks.

answer: So the value asked for is [[answer]].
